samplingInterval.description: The sampling interval, in seconds, of the downstream audio quality data.

startTime.description: The date and time when this audio session started.

endTime.description: The date and time when this audio session ended.

packetLoss.description: The percentage of audio packet loss, as a float between 0.0 and 100.0, during each sampling interval.

latency.description: The average latency, in milliseconds, during each sampling interval.

mediaBitRate.description: The bitrate of the incoming audio.

codec.description: The codec of the incoming audio.

transportType.description: The network protocol used for video transmission.
